stock.description: Hanison Construction Holdings Limited functions as an investment vehicle, with its core business centered on the construction industry within Hong Kong. The company's operations are diversified across seven primary segments. These encompass general building and civil engineering works, specialized interior fit-out and refurbishment projects, and the design, sourcing, and installation of various building materials. As a contractor, it constructs a wide range of properties, including residential, commercial, industrial, educational, and recreational facilities, frequently offering integrated design-and-build services. Its materials division supplies and installs items such as kitchen cabinets, different types of timber and engineered flooring, suspended ceiling systems, metal cladding, and fire-rated and composite boards for developers and major contractors. This segment also provides plumbing pipes (including galvanized, black, stainless steel, and polyethylene) and associated fittings. The interior and renovation arm handles the upkeep and modernization of clubhouses, retail complexes, office spaces, residential units, industrial buildings, and institutional establishments. Furthermore, Hanison is involved in property development, managing the complete process from land acquisition and feasibility studies to design, construction, sales, and marketing. It also delivers comprehensive property agency and management services, covering rental collection, leasing, and overall property administration. Additionally, the company distributes health supplements, medical equipment, and traditional Chinese medicine, and offers plant maintenance services. Established in 1989, Hanison Construction Holdings Limited is based in Sha Tin, Hong Kong.
